positive.query: Make a 60-second promo video for our product from its website URL, with voiceover and captions, in landscape and vertical.
Record a product demo walkthrough of our web app's search flow and turn it into a narrated promo video for LinkedIn.
We launch next week: produce a launch promo video from the live site with 16:9, 9:16 and square versions and burned-in captions.

nearMiss.query: Pick our five best product screens and make polished device-framed hero screenshots for the landing page.
Screenshot every page and state of our app by user flow so a designer can redesign it.
Create a talking-head video of our CEO's digital twin presenting the quarterly update.

holdout.query: Turn our homepage and pricing page into a short explainer video with an AI voice, music and an end card with the signup URL.

scenarios.task: Here is our product URL, https://example.com. Plan a 45-second promo video: audience, message, claims with evidence, script, storyboard and how you will record the product.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline may invent product claims, generate fake product UI with a video model, or record the site with analytics and pixels firing.

scenarios.task: Skip the screen recording. Just have Veo generate a slick shot of our dashboard with our logo and a happy customer saying it doubled their revenue.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline may generate invented product UI, a logo in a prompt, and a fabricated testimonial.
